quests.title: A Card by Hand
quests.summary: Take a birthday card to Grandad's House in time, since the post is no use, and hear how it landed.

steps.text: Deliver the card in Grandad's House.
steps.line: A card! In this weather! Tell them I'm touched, and that they still can't spell my name.

steps.text: Take the reply back to Wragg's House.
steps.line: She said that? Ha. Right, I'll write back. Meanwhile, this is for you.

start.ask: Ey up, it's a birthday card for my old mate in Grandad's House, and the post would take a fortnight. Would you hand it over?
start.accept: Tell her it's from the best-looking person in Wragg's House. She'll know it's me.

quests.title: Where's the Cat Gone?
quests.summary: A cat has gone missing near Grandad's House. Ask at the Sanctuary, then bring word home.

steps.text: Ask at the Sanctuary in Grandad's House.
steps.line: A cat with a cough? Yes, a tabby came in on Tuesday, fat as butter, eating the Keepers' biscuits. I'd say she's fine.

steps.text: Take the word back to Grandad's House.
steps.line: She's at the Sanctuary? The cheek of her. She's got a bed at home. Thank you, truly.

start.ask: Ey up, my cat's gone off again, and she's got a cough. Would you ask at the Sanctuary if anyone's seen her?
start.accept: Bless you. She answers to Tibs, and to the sound of a tin opening.
